name: EPIC 211579059

text.card: A red giant 6,411 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.81 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,117 K at its surface.
